map.输入最大流量、工作压力、控制方式与阀门功能，计算阀通径并推荐合适的阀门类型与规格: From maximum flow, working pressure, control mode and valve function, calculate the valve bore and recommend a suitable valve type and size.
map.💡 阀通径 d = √(4Q/(π·v·6×10⁴))，按流速 4~6m/s 计: 💡 Valve bore d = √(4Q/(π·v·6×10⁴)), computed at velocity 4~6 m/s, rounded to standard bore DN series
map.电磁换向阀流量一般不超过 60~80L/min，大流量用电液换向阀: Solenoid directional valve flow is generally up to 60~80 L/min; use electro-hydraulic directional valve for large flow
map.伺服阀适用于高精度小流量场合，对油液清洁度要求高（ISO4406 15/13/1: Servo valve suits high-precision small-flow cases and demands high oil cleanliness (ISO4406 15/13/10)
map.压力阀：低压小流量选直动式，高压大流量选先导式: Pressure valve: low pressure small flow uses direct-acting, high pressure large flow uses pilot-operated
map.选型通径应略大于计算值，保证流速在允许范围: Selected bore should be slightly larger than the computed value to keep velocity within the allowed range
map.按压差与阀口面积估算过阀流量。: Estimate flow through valve by pressure difference and orifice area.
map.节流调速的流量-压差关系。: Flow-pressure relation of throttling speed control.
map.选阀通径满足最大流量压降。: Select valve bore to meet max-flow pressure drop.
map.Cd=1、A 对应 100 L/min 通径、Δp=5 bar、ρ=870 →: Cd=1, A for 100 L/min bore, Δp=5 bar, ρ=870 → Q≈Cd·A·√(2×5e5/870), check flow at rated pressure drop.
map.Δp 翻倍流量仅增 41%（√Δp），节流调速非线性明显。: Doubling Δp raises flow only 41% (√Δp); throttling speed control is clearly nonlinear.
map.∝√Δp，调压即调流量，故节流调速有软特性。: ∝√Δp; adjusting pressure adjusts flow, so throttling speed control has a soft characteristic.
map.按额定流量下允许压降选，过大阀贵、过小压损高发热。: Choose by allowed pressure drop at rated flow; too large a valve is costly, too small has high loss and heating.
map.液压阀功能选型工具根据最大流量、工作压力、控制方式与阀门功能，按允许流速计算阀通: The hydraulic valve selection tool computes valve bore from maximum flow, working pressure, control mode and valve function by allowable velocity and rounds to the standard DN series, then recommends a suitable valve type (directional/relief/throttle/proportional/servo, etc.) by function need. It applies to control-element selection in hydraulic systems.
map.通径自动计算与标准圆整: Automatic bore calculation and standard rounding
map.按功能与控制方式推荐类型: Type recommendation by function and control mode
map.比例伺服系统元件选型: Proportional and servo system component selection
